headline: WisdomTree Shares Surge 11% Following Third-Quarter Earnings Beat
summary: WisdomTree stock soared 11% after the asset manager reported better-than-expected third-quarter financial results.
why: Earnings beats for asset managers signal stronger fee-generating assets under management and operational efficiency, directly impacting investor sentiment.

impacts.name: WisdomTree
impacts.why: WisdomTree reported a third-quarter earnings beat.
